lesson18-integrated-and-short-pronominal.acceptedJob: Offer integrated antecessive placement only when both carriers are licensed, enforce the short-pronominal utterance boundary, and keep nonsemantic spelling variants as cues.

lesson18-marked-supplementation.acceptedJob: Apply optional in to the complete adjoined unit while preserving role, reference, number, determinacy, topic status, nesting, and typed demonstrative identity.

lesson18-discontinuous-supplementation.acceptedJob: Derive discontinuity from the selected constituent order and preserve all typed head and recursive supplementation links across intervening clauses.

lesson18-collective-and-named-partner.acceptedJob: Use typed plural reference and participant identity to derive collective and named-partner agreement, preserving the unresolved moch analysis without adding exception switches.

lesson18-male-bonding.acceptedJob: Use owner-issued speaker sex and group membership to derive or block first-person-plural oquich-tli cross-reference against third-person heads.

lesson18-ayi-silent-object.acceptedJob: Derive overt nonspecific tla or the silent specific-object head from patient specificity, bind a captured specific patient to that head, preserve the ayi/ax stem relation, and exclude ichtequi.

lesson18-principal-deletion-and-command-.acceptedJob: Derive licensed ca-h deletion from the captured structure, promote the adverbial modifier to proxy principal, preserve the supplementary subject as the surface subject, and keep second-person optative supplements classified as command subjects rather than vocatives.

lesson18-real-vocatives.acceptedJob: Build real vocatives from a typed third-person NNC and owner-issued speaker sex, deriving obligatory male or female realization and exposing only licensed optional glottal-y or silent plural-in variants.

lesson18-free-order-and-complete-clauses.acceptedJob: Preserve the typed principal, role, reference, repetition, recursion, and complete-clause graph across every licensed order, asking only for order or a genuinely ambiguous structural choice.
